title: Analyze intermediary, credential, protocol, and ransomware attack paths: concept decisions 2
teachingQuestion: Is this an intermediary, credential, protocol, endpoint, authorization, recovery, or availability failure?
focalInsight: Secure channels need validated peers; credential compromise and ransomware need protected, rehearsed recovery.
caption: Read across a row to connect meaning, decision and consequence. Use the retrieval answer to check your explanation after reading the linked scenario.

nodes.label: Privileged Account Management
nodes.definition: Attributable, constrained management of high-authority accounts.
nodes.detail: Attributable, constrained management of high-authority accounts.
nodes.decision: Use unique identities, strong authentication, least privilege, monitoring, and emergency controls.
nodes.failureExample: A shared admin account encrypts production and deletes backups without attribution.
nodes.retrievalAnswer: Privileged account control reduces systemic credential consequence.
